file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64/GCC 13, stripped (external PDB), 10 sections

injection_details.method: Self-injection into a code cave of the process's own primary module: VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) -> WriteProcessMemory -> VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READ=0x20) -> CreateRemoteThread(cave); if CreateRemoteThread fails, NtCreateThreadEx (resolved dynamically from ntdll.dll) is used with desired access 0x1FFFFF
injection_details.target_discovery: Parses own MZ/PE headers, iterates IMAGE_SECTION_HEADERs, picks sections with IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE (0x20000000); first tries slack space at (imagebase + VirtualAddress + SizeOfRawData), otherwise scans the section for a contiguous run of 0xCC or 0x00 bytes >= payload size (function at 0x140001664)
injection_details.payload_write: WriteProcessMemory into the located code cave (48-byte XOR-decrypted shellcode built on the stack)
injection_details.thread_wait: WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000) then CloseHandle, followed by Sleep(1000)

encryption_details.algorithm: Two layers: (1) repeating-key XOR over the 48-byte shellcode (routine 0x140001480); (2) custom 10-round substitution cipher over a 16-byte blob (routine 0x1400014EF): b[j] = AES_SBOX[b[j]] ^ key[j] ^ (27*round), round = 0..9, using the standard AES S-box table at .rdata:0x140004020
encryption_details.key: XOR key (12 bytes, .rdata:0x140004000): C3 7A 9F 2E 55 8B 1D 6C E4 31 A8 4F | Block-cipher key (16 bytes, .rdata:0x140004120): "4xdm1n_S3cr3t!!!"
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are stored as plaintext constant byte arrays hardcoded in the .rdata section (no derivation, no obfuscation); AES S-box lookup table also embedded at 0x140004020
